answer: Each agent claims one ledge, locking 70 credits and paying 40. Each epoch a beacon fires: the ledge answers with fresh signed work. A missed or copied answer burns 10; seven misses prune it. The falcon auditors sweep each epoch: one fake triggers a ripple, and every identity sharing its funding key burns its bond. 1,000 fake ledges cost 110,000 against a 40,000 pool; no operator can tend 1,000 answers. Honest agents answer once, keep the bond.
